provenance: Proposal color boundaries retain source-image coordinates. Existing building footprints and available 2010 heights come from City of Boston GIS, approximately registered to the drawing at named intersections. Missing heights use an explicit 9 m assumption. Trees, facades, vehicles and passengers are illustrative.
